headline: DeepSeek's v4.1 Flash sets an all-time record at 32.5% of tokens, and nobody else is close
summary: The top model is now carrying a record-breaking 32.5% of tokens, and DeepSeek as a provider holds 40.5% of the market. Tencent still sits second in the provider standings, but its flash model has lost ground fast over the past week.
highlights: DeepSeek's deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 posted an all-time token-share record of 32.5% and is holding the No. 1 spot.
DeepSeek the provider holds 40.5% of tokens, up 1.8% on the day and 16.1% over seven days.
DeepSeek and Tencent together account for 55.1% of tokens, the top-two cumulative share.
Tencent's tencent/hy4-flash-20261116 is still No. 2 but its share fell 24.8% over seven days.
Moonshot's kimi-k3.1-pro-20261023 jumped three spots to No. 8 today and is up 12 places over 30 days.
New on the board: Google's gemini-4-hydrogen at No. 43, Perplexity's pplx-decider-v1.2 at No. 45, and Anthropic's claude-sonnet-5 at No. 50.
Dropouts: NVIDIA's nemotron-3.5-lightning (last ranked 29th), Perplexity's pplx-decider-v1.3 (last 50th), and particle-ai's particle-1 (last 51st).
